title.zh: 扩大第8256号共和国法所规定的东达沃省建城纪念日与宗教节日作为特别非工作公众假日的适用范围，以涵盖该省各市、市镇及描笼涯，并为此修正第8256号共和国法的法案
title.en: An Act Expanding the Coverage of Foundation Days and Feast Days as Special Nonworking Public Holidays in the Province of Davao Oriental to Include Cities, Municipalities and Barangays Therein, Amending for the Purpose Republic Act No.8256

title.vi: Đạo luật mở rộng phạm vi Ngày Thành lập và Ngày Lễ Thánh theo Đạo luật Cộng hòa số 8256 thành ngày lễ công cộng không làm việc đặc biệt cho các thành phố, thị xã và barangay thuộc Tỉnh Davao Oriental
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติขยายขอบเขตวันครบรอบการก่อตั้งและวันฉลองเทศกาลตามพระราชบัญญัติฉบับที่8256ให้ครอบคลุมเมืองอำเภอและบารังไกย์ในจังหวัดดาเวาออรีเอนตัลในฐานะวันหยุดราชการพิเศษที่ไม่ทำงานและแก้ไขพระราชบัญญัติฉบับที่8256
title.id: Undang-Undang Memperluas Cakupan Hari Pendirian dan Hari Raya menurut Undang-Undang Republik Nomor 8256 sebagai Hari Libur Umum Khusus Tanpa Kerja di Kota, Kotamadya, dan Barangay di Provinsi Davao Oriental dengan Mengamandemen Undang-Undang Republik Nomor 8256
title.ms: Akta Memperluas Skop Hari Penubuhan dan Hari Perayaan mengikut Akta Republik No.8256 sebagai Cuti Umum Khas Tanpa Bekerja di Bandar, Perbandaran dan Barangay di Wilayah Davao Oriental dengan Mengubahsuai Akta Republik No.8256

text.en:
Section 1 of Republic Act No. 8256 is hereby amended to read as follows:
“
The foundation days and feast days in the Province of Davao Oriental, and the cities, municipalities, and barangays therein are hereby declared as special nonworking public holidays”.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
